Gold Stakes on new Decks everyday. Sometimes we even win. Learn to play Balatro less bad, on the highest level of difficulty. Today, we test Flash Card and Spare Trousers against each other and generally discuss +Mult scaling in the game.

The "Extra Credit" mod Github page: https://github.com/GuilloryCraft/ExtraCredit

For more information about the mods I use, you can join the Balatro University Discord either by one-time Twitch subscription or minimum Ko-Fi contribution. After signing up, go to your Discord Settings and look for "Connections."
